input: Start a nature journal with pressed leaves and sketches

gold.taskTitle: Start a Nature Journal with Pressed Leaves and Sketches
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to create a personal nature journal that combines pressed leaves and hand-drawn sketches as a creative and observational practice.

questions.title: What type of journal or notebook do you have in mind?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants a store-bought blank journal, a sketchbook, a binder, or a handmade book.

questions.title: Where will you be collecting leaves and nature material?
questions.description: Identify the setting - backyard, local park, hiking trails, or travels - to plan accordingly.

questions.title: Do you have any sketching experience or art supplies already?
questions.description: Gauge the user's skill level and what materials they currently own to avoid redundant purchases.

questions.title: How do you plan to press and preserve the leaves?
questions.description: Determine if the user wants to use a flower press, heavy books, or another method for pressing and drying specimens.

questions.title: Is this for a specific season, event, or ongoing practice?
questions.description: Clarify whether the journal is tied to a particular time of year, a trip, a school project, or a long-term hobby.

questions.title: Will you add written notes, labels, or only visuals?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants to include scientific names, personal observations, dates, or purely artistic content.

questions.title: What is your budget for supplies and materials?
questions.description: Understand spending limits to recommend appropriate journals, presses, pens, and adhesives within their range.
